sql_error_unrecovered.question: What percent of total revenue came from the Electronics category?
sql_error_unrecovered.answer: The percent of total revenue from the Electronics category is 25.00%.
sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN products.category = 'Electronics' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / SUM(revenue) * 100 AS Electronics_Revenue_Pct
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS revenue,
            o.customer_id
        FROM
            orders o
        JOIN
            order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
        GROUP BY
            o.customer_id
    ) o
JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS revenue,
            p.id AS product_id
        FROM
            orders o
        JOIN
            order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
        JOIN
            products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
        WHERE
            p.category = 'Electronics'
        GROUP BY
            p.id
    ) e
ON
    o.customer_id = e.product_id

made_up_answer.question: What was our total profit in 2025?
sql:
SELECT SUM(T1.revenue) AS total_revenue_2025
FROM (
    SELECT o.id, SUM(T2.quantity * T2.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items T2 ON o.id = T2.order_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025'
    GROUP BY o.id
) T1
